test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text:
Consider the following pairs of electrons

(A) (a) n=3, l=1, ml=1,ms=+12
(b) n=3, l=2,ml=1,ms=+12

(C) (a) n=4, l=2,ml=2,ms=+12
(b) n=3,l=2,ml=2,ms=+12

Given below are two statement : one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R

Assertion A : 5f electron can participate in bonding to a far greater extent than 4f electrons

Reason R : 5f orbitals are not as buried as 4f orbitals

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.text: A is false but R is true
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
